claims.sourceText: Wikipedia, Edwards Air Force Base — DEMOTED from Tier 1 (cited to a secondary/encyclopedic source); needs primary replacement
claims.text: Edwards AFB covers 470 square miles around Rogers Dry Lake; it was renamed from Muroc in December 1949 for Capt. Glen Edwards; it hosts the Air Force Test Center, the USAF Test Pilot School and NASA Armstrong Flight Research Center.

edges.label: Edwards defines the acknowledged-testing boundary that Groom Lake was built to escape
edges.note: Groom Lake exists because the U-2 could not be tested at Edwards. The pair therefore mark the boundary between the acknowledged and unacknowledged US flight test enterprise.
